chunks: And Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
If the one who asks knew what is in asking, no one would ask anyone; and if the giver knew what is in giving, no one would turn anyone away.

key_terms.السَّائِلُ: the one who asks from others
key_terms.الْمَسْأَلَةِ: the act of asking or begging

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام teach about asking people and giving charity?
ai.summary: Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام teaches that asking from others carries a grave weight, while giving carries immense virtue. The hadith encourages dignity in need and generosity toward those who ask.
